reviewer.note: Review at 9366301b (main bytes), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md. Bed frames: the top rails carry a stamped diagonal tick every ~4.5 texels that reads as twisted rope, not grain; the lower rails carry flat grey 2x2 dot nails on the dark seam with no lit pixel or rust (calibration C1 "dot nails"); no butt joints on 130-texel boards. Fix: grain as irregular 2-4 px streaks along each board, butt joints every 14-30 px with a nail head (dark, lit pixel above, sitting in the board) beside each, one of three sibling ramps per board. Char marks are flat one-tone slate pills laid over unchanged grain (stickers), and the frames are otherwise untouched by a fire that burned the beds: char the rail tops and ends in clusters (timber tones 0-1 with a lit crack line), blister and split the boards nearest the ash. Burnt stalks are 1-texel dark lines with no lit side: 2-texel stalks with a lit west edge. Rejected detector finding: detail.light on the ash rows (random ash clusters, no light reading).
